## 2. Core Service Offerings & Scope of Deliverables

### A. Custom Web & SaaS Platform Engineering (SAC 998311)
- **Architecture**: Modular MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and Next.js App Router applications.
- **Frontend Stack**: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, Vite, Responsive Mobile-First Design.
- **Backend Stack**: Node.js microservices, Python FastAPI, PostgreSQL / MongoDB with indexing for sub-10ms queries.
- **Key Deliverables**: Multi-tenant database schema, JWT / PBKDF2 authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), Stripe & Razorpay checkout integration, automated CI/CD pipelines.

### B. Cross-Platform Mobile Applications (SAC 998313)
- **Architecture**: React Native (Expo / Bare Workflow) and Flutter.
- **Key Deliverables**: Unified iOS and Android codebase, offline SQLite caching, background push notifications (APNs / FCM), hardware Bluetooth / GPS telemetry, App Store & Google Play submission and approval management.

### C. Enterprise AI & Large Language Model (LLM) Integrations (SAC 998319)
- **Architecture**: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using LangChain / LlamaIndex and OpenAI / Anthropic Claude / DeepSeek models.
- **Vector Search**: Pinecone / Chroma vector stores with text embeddings for internal enterprise knowledge bases.
- **Security & Privacy**: Zero-Data-Retention (ZDR) API contracts, tenant-isolated vector namespaces, and on-premise local model options (Ollama / vLLM).
- **Key Deliverables**: Automated tier-1 support triage bots, document parsing agents, and automated data extraction pipelines.

### D. Process Automation & API Orchestration (SAC 998319)
- **Architecture**: Event-driven worker queues (BullMQ, Redis), Webhooks, and custom integration scripts.
- **Key Deliverables**: Real-time bi-directional CRM syncing (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk), automated invoice reconciliation, Slack/WhatsApp alert bots, and automated email sequences (Resend API).

### E. Cloud Engineering, DevOps & 24/7 SLA Support (SAC 998314)
- **Cloud Infrastructure**: AWS (ECS, S3, RDS, CloudFront), Vercel, Cloudflare Enterprise.
- **Key Deliverables**: Containerized Docker microservices, zero-downtime migration protocols, SSL/TLS certificate management, automated daily database backups with point-in-time recovery, and 99.9% uptime SLA warranty.

## 3. Engagement Models, Pricing Structure & Billing Terms

| Engagement Model | Ideal For | Typical Timeline | Pricing Range (USD / INR) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Fixed Milestone MVP** | Seed-stage startups & new product launches | 2 to 6 weeks | $6,000 – $25,000 / ₹5,00,000 – ₹20,00,000 |
| **Dedicated Engineering Pod** | Scaling SaaS & enterprise team extension | Monthly retainer | $8,000 – $20,000 / month |
| **Custom AI & Automation Sprint** | Workflow automation & RAG pipelines | 2 to 4 weeks | $5,000 – $15,000 / ₹4,00,000 – ₹12,00,000 |

### Billing & Tax Terms:
- **Domestic (India)**: Tax invoice with 18% GST (9% CGST + 9% SGST for Karnataka, 18% IGST for other states). UPI QR, Netbanking (NEFT/RTGS), and Razorpay accepted.
- **International (US, UK, EU, UAE, Global)**: 0% Tax under Export of Services Letter of Undertaking (LUT). Wire Transfer (ACH/SWIFT) and international card checkout accepted.
- **Payment Terms**: Standard 50% upfront milestone retainer, 50% upon final delivery sign-off (or Net 15/30 for enterprise MSA accounts).

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ Matrix)

### Q1: Who owns the intellectual property (IP) and source code?
**A**: The client owns 100% of all intellectual property, source code, Figma design files, database schemas, and documentation upon payment completion. Tanvo Tech does not claim any recurring license fees or vendor lock-in rights.

### Q2: How does Tanvo Tech handle communication during active projects?
**A**: Every client receives access to a dedicated Client Portal Workspace (`portal.tanvo.tech`) with real-time sprint changelogs, deliverable sign-offs, and transparent roadmap progress. In addition, updates are dispatched via WhatsApp and Email.

### Q3: What happens after project launch?
**A**: Every build includes a complimentary 30-day post-launch warranty covering any bug fixes, security patches, and performance optimizations. Clients can then transition to a monthly SLA retainer for continuous feature development and DevOps management.
